title: GTA VI: all the news on Rockstar’s next entry in the Grand Theft Auto series

title: China’s supernodes go mainstream as AI model sizes grow
snippet: Supernodes were everywhere at last month’s World Artificial Intelligence Conference (WAIC) in Shanghai. Assemblies of dozens or hundreds of computer chips and associated hardware, supernodes are China’s way around the United States’ ban on the export of the most advanced artificial intelligence (AI) chips.
